In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
hypoxia and pH in solid tumors are correlated, but only on a larger scale and not on a micrometer scale.

the heterogeneous concentration of the oxygen and the buffers in the blood vessels and their distribution inside the tumor are the main reasons for the lack of correlation and the inhomogeneity of hypoxia and acidosis in the tumor microenvironment.
the correlation between hypoxic and acidic regions is related to the heterogeneities in oxygen and buffers in the blood vessels.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the lack of the correlation between acidity and hypoxia is related to the heterogeneous distribution of buffers and oxygen inside the blood vessel and the network of blood vessel.

the lack of the correlation between pH and hypoxia and the heterogeneity of these factors in the tumor microenvironment are related to the in vivo heterogeneous distribution of buffers and oxygen inside the blood vessel network.

the lack of a correlation between hypoxic and acidic microenvironments in solid tumors is due to the heterogeneous distribution of the blood vessels, oxygen and buffers inside the blood vessels and their heterogeneous consumption by cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the lack of correlations between hypoxia, acidity, and metabolism is not due to the intrinsic properties of cells, but rather to the heterogeneity in the tumor environment, which is related to the heterogeneous distribution of blood vessels.

the microenvironmental heterogeneity is a consequence of the heterogeneous concentration of the nutrients and oxygen in the network of blood vessel and the cell metabolism and the lack of correlation is due to the heterogeneous concentration and distribution of buffers in the tumor.
, in the absence of any intervention, the lack of correlation and heterogeneity in the distribution of pH in solid tumors is an inherent characteristic of the tumor microenvironment.
